record.paper_title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
record.original_question: Let A be a quasi-Banach operator ideal of exact trace type 1/r, let d_{r,\infty}(N0) be the shift-monotone sequence ideal of sequences with dyadic decay O(2^{-k/r}), and let A^{APP}_{r,\infty} be the ideal of operators S in A for which the dyadic A-approximation numbers (a_{2^k}(S|A)) lie in d_{r,\infty}(N0). Theorem 1.21 constructs traces on A^{APP}_{r,\infty} from 2^{-1/r}S_+-invariant linear forms φ on d_{r,\infty}(N0) by choosing an (A,d_{r,\infty})-representation S=∑_{k>=0} S_k and setting φ_{r,\infty}(S|A)=φ((2^{-k/r} trace(S_k))_k). Show that every trace on A^{APP}_{r,\infty} is one of these traces.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Let $\mathfrak{A}$ be a quasi-Banach operator ideal on the class of all Banach spaces that is of exact trace type $1/r$ for some $r>0$ (i.e. equipped with a continuous trace on its finite-rank component compatible with the natural quasi-norm at order $1/r$). For an operator $S\in\mathfrak{A}(X,X)$, denote by $a_n(S\mid\mathfrak{A})$ its $n$-th $\mathfrak{A}$-approximation number.

Let $d_{r,\infty}(\mathbb{N}_0)$ be the shift-monotone sequence ideal consisting of all scalar sequences $\xi=(\xi_k)_{k\ge 0}$ such that $\xi_k = O(2^{-k/r})$, and let $S_+$ denote the forward shift on $d_{r,\infty}(\mathbb{N}_0)$.

Define
$$\mathfrak{A}^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty} \;:=\; \bigl\{\, S\in\mathfrak{A} \;:\; (a_{2^k}(S\mid\mathfrak{A}))_{k\ge 0}\in d_{r,\infty}(\mathbb{N}_0)\,\bigr\}.$$

Construction of traces. Every operator $S\in\mathfrak{A}^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty}$ admits an $(\mathfrak{A},d_{r,\infty})$-representation
$$S=\sum_{k\ge 0} S_k,$$
where each $S_k$ is a finite-rank operator of rank at most $2^k$, with appropriate quasi-norm control. Given any linear form $\varphi$ on $d_{r,\infty}(\mathbb{N}_0)$ that is invariant under $2^{-1/r}S_+$, define
$$\varphi_{r,\infty}(S\mid\mathfrak{A}) := \varphi\bigl( (2^{-k/r}\,\mathrm{trace}(S_k))_{k\ge 0}\bigr).$$
This formula yields a well-defined trace on $\mathfrak{A}^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty}$.

Problem. Prove that conversely every (continuous) trace on the operator ideal $\mathfrak{A}^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty}$ arises in this way from some $2^{-1/r}S_+$-invariant linear form $\varphi$ on $d_{r,\infty}(\mathbb{N}_0)$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an explicit open problem in Pietsch's recent survey on traces on operator ideals over all Banach spaces (zbMATH 7709580). Related classifications are known in the Hilbert-space setting via the equivalence with shift-monotone sequence ideals, but no published resolution for the Banach-space ideal $\mathfrak{A}^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty}$ was found.

status_evidence.title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Lists open problems on traces of operator ideals defined over all Banach spaces.

status_evidence.title: Traces on Operator Ideals and Related Linear Forms on Sequence Ideals (Part IV)
status_evidence.snippet: Describes traces via shift-monotone sequence ideals in the Hilbert-space setting.
status_evidence.claim: The analogous Hilbert-space classification is established, but the Banach-space classification is not addressed.
